title: Dialect-Level Generalization of Arabic Sentiment Classifiers: An Exact-Duplicate-Free, Uncertainty-Aware Evaluation of Encoders and LLMs
description: Replication bundle, model predictions, evaluation artifacts, and manuscript source for 'Dialect-Level Generalization of Arabic Sentiment Classifiers: An Exact-Duplicate-Free, Uncertainty-Aware Evaluation of Encoders and LLMs'. Includes multi-seed predictions across 11 encoders and 4 instruction-tuned LLMs on ArSarcasm and ArSarcasm-v2.
